example.en: Rubber band, being elastic, is useful in binding loose items.
example.zh: 橡皮筋有彈性,對於固定鬆散的東西很有用。

example.en: Electronics is one of the fastest growing industries in Taiwan.
example.zh: 電子業是台灣發展快速的工業之一。

example.en: Wang Wei's elegant poetry has fascinated readers for centuries.
example.zh: 王維優美的詩作幾世紀以來令讀者著迷。

example.en: Fatty foods should be eliminated from the diet.
example.zh: 飲食要去除高油脂食物。

example.en: They went to a reception at the American Embassy in Moscow.
example.zh: 他們去參加了莫斯科的美國大使館的招待會。

example.en: They put emphasis on quality rather than on quantity.
example.zh: 他們重質不重量。

example.en: A romantic encounter brought us together.
example.zh: 一次浪漫邂逅使我們相識。

example.en: I could endure it no longer.
example.zh: 我對此再也無法忍受了。

example.en: Governments make laws, and the police enforce them.
example.zh: 政府立法,警察部門執行法律。

example.en: A good way to enlarge your vocabulary is to read a daily newspaper.
example.zh: 每天閱讀報紙是擴大你的字彙量的好方法。

example.en: He has an enormous amount of work to finish by Friday.
example.zh: 他週五以前要完成大量的工作。

example.en: Is money essential to happiness?
example.zh: 金錢對於幸福是不可或缺的嗎?

example.en: She estimated that the work would take three months.
example.zh: 她估計這項工作需要三個月。

example.en: We shall need to evaluate how the new material stands up to wear and tear.
example.zh: 我們需要評估新質材耐磨損的程度。

example.en: We need to carry out a proper evaluation of the new system.
example.zh: 我們需要為新系統做適當的評估。

example.en: The eventual decision came after weeks of discussion.
example.zh: 經過數星期的討論後,最終決定出來了。

example.en: It was evident that she still loved him.
example.zh: 很顯然她還是愛他。

example.en: The media exaggerated the importance of the event.
example.zh: 媒體誇大了這事件的重要性。

example.en: Everyone makes mistakes, and I am no exception.
example.zh: 每個人都會犯錯,我也不例外。

example.en: Why don't you exhibit his portrait?
example.zh: 你為什麼不展出他的畫像?

example.en: Water expands as it freezes.
example.zh: 水結冰時會擴大。

senses.zh: 爆炸(性)的, 一觸即發的

example.en: Certain gases are highly explosive.
example.zh: 有些氣體極易爆炸。

senses.zh: 延長, 延伸, 伸出

example.en: The professor agreed to extend the deadline.
example.zh: 教授同意延長截止日期。

example.en: We were shocked by the extent of the damage.
example.zh: 受損程度令人震驚。

example.en: The hotel has its own pool and leisure facilities.
example.zh: 這個旅館有自己的游泳池和遊樂設施。

example.en: He remained faithful to his wife all his life.
example.zh: 他終生對妻子忠貞。

example.en: You look fantastic in that dress.
example.zh: 你穿那件洋裝看起來漂亮極了。

example.en: George lives in a world of fantasy.
example.zh: 喬治整天生活在幻想的世界中。

example.en: He bid farewell to his colleagues after 15 years' service.
example.zh: 服務十五年後他向同事道別。

example.en: Fasten your seat belt.
example.zh: 繫緊安全帶。

senses.zh: 致命的, 嚴重的, 生死攸關的

example.en: The shot was fatal.
example.zh: 這是致命的一槍。

example.en: Reaction to the plan has been generally favorable.
example.zh: 民眾對這個計劃的反應普遍是贊同的。

example.en: Can you send your report to me by fax?
example.zh: 你可以用傳真寄報告給我嗎?

example.en: We prepared a feast for the wedding.
example.zh: 我們為婚禮準備了盛宴。

example.en: They waited for the ferry to return.
example.zh: 他們等候渡船返回。

example.en: The land is so fertile that three crops a year can grow.
example.zh: 這片土地很肥沃,一年可種三季莊稼。

example.en: Please fetch my glasses for me from the other room.
example.zh: 請到另一個房間把我的眼鏡拿來。

example.en: There is fierce competition between the two companies.
example.zh: 這兩家公司之間競爭激烈。

example.en: Children hang their Christmas stockings above the fireplace.
example.zh: 孩子們把聖誕襪掛在壁爐上。

example.en: Her husband always flatters her by praising her cooking.
example.zh: 她的丈夫總是讚美她的廚藝來奉承她。

example.en: You can buy old or used goods in a flea market.
example.zh: 你可以在跳蚤市場買到舊東西或是二手貨。

example.en: He flushed angrily.
example.zh: 他氣得滿臉通紅。

example.en: She scraped the foam off her coffee.
example.zh: 她刮掉咖啡上的泡沫。

example.en: Clouds are formations of condensed water vapor.
example.zh: 雲是水汽凝聚而成。

senses.zh: 方法, 公式, 配方

example.en: There's no magic formula for success.
example.zh: 成功沒有祕訣。

example.en: They defended the fort against enemy's heavy attack.
example.zh: 他們守著堡壘抗拒敵人的猛攻。

example.en: The search team is ready to go fossil hunting.
example.zh: 這個研究團隊準備好去搜尋化石。

senses.zh: 易碎的, 纖細的, 脆弱的

example.en: They carefully packed the fragile china into cartons.
example.zh: 他們小心將易碎瓷器裝入紙箱。

example.en: The frost killed the young tomato plants.
example.zh: 寒霜凍死了番茄幼苗。

example.en: The father frowned on his son's behavior.
example.zh: 父親不滿他兒子的行為。

example.en: Thick fog frustrated their attempt to land on the tiny island.
example.zh: 濃霧阻撓了他們登陸小島的嘗試。

example.en: He felt a sense of frustration after repeated failures.
example.zh: 經過多次失敗後,他有一種挫折感。

senses.zh: 實用的, 正常運作的

example.en: We want our new kitchen to be functional.
example.zh: 我們希望新廚房很實用。

example.en: Hundreds of mourners attended the mayor's funeral.
example.zh: 好幾百名追悼者參加了市長的葬禮。

example.en: Her room was plainly furnished with a bed and a desk.
example.zh: 她的房間傢俱很簡單,只有一張床和書桌。

example.en: He gazed admiringly at her.
example.zh: 他愛慕地凝視她。

senses.zh: 齒輪, 傳動裝置, 裝備

example.en: He left their camping gear at the mountain lodge and had to return to get it back.
example.zh: 他把露營裝備留在登山小屋,所以得折返去取回。

example.en: Thank you for your generosity.
example.zh: 感謝您的慷慨。

example.en: Rats and flies spread germs.
example.zh: 老鼠和蒼蠅散播細菌。

example.en: He was a guard of gigantic strength.
example.zh: 他是個具有巨人般力氣的衛士。

example.en: They caught a glimpse of a green car.
example.zh: 他們瞥見了一部綠色的車。

example.en: This plant can grow in many parts of the globe.
example.zh: 這種植物能在地球上許多地方生長。

example.en: The team won a glorious victory.
example.zh: 這支球隊贏得了輝煌勝利。

example.en: He buys and sells leather goods.
example.zh: 他買賣皮件。

example.en: The old lady used to be a graceful dancer.
example.zh: 這位老太太曾是位舞姿優美的舞者。

senses.zh: 親切的, 和藹的, 有風度的

example.en: Gracious hosts always try to make their guests comfortable.
example.zh: 親切的主人總想設法讓他們的客人舒適。

example.en: This graph shows how the number of road accidents has increased over the last ten years.
example.zh: 曲線圖顯示過去十年公路車禍數的增長情況。

example.en: I am grateful to have you help me repair the house.
example.zh: 承你幫忙修繕房子,我十分感激。

example.en: I would like to express my gratitude to him for his generosity.
example.zh: 我要感謝他的慷慨。

example.en: With so little medical equipment, there's a grave risk of infection.
example.zh: 如此簡陋的醫療設備有極嚴重的感染風險。

senses.zh: 油膩的, 沾有油污的

example.en: I don't care for greasy fried chickens.
example.zh: 我不喜歡油膩的炸雞。

example.en: The mother went mad with grief after her child died.
example.zh: 孩子死後,母親因悲痛而發瘋了。

example.en: The TV set comes with a year's guarantee.
example.zh: 這架電視機有一年的保固期。

example.en: They used to be friends but a great gulf has developed between them.
example.zh: 他們過去是朋友,但現在兩人間已產生了極大的分歧。

example.en: Habitual ways of thinking are hard to change.
example.zh: 習慣性的思考方式很難改變。

example.en: Production has come to a halt owing to the lack of raw materials.
example.zh: 由於缺少原料,生產已陷入停頓。

example.en: Is that signature your handwriting?
example.zh: 那個簽名是你的筆跡嗎?

senses.zh: 五金器具, 電腦硬體

example.en: Father deals in hardware.
example.zh: 我父親做五金生意。

example.en: I wish everyone could live together in harmony.
example.zh: 但願大家能和睦融洽地生活在一起。

example.en: His theory met with harsh criticism from colleagues.
example.zh: 他的理論遭到同事們嚴厲的批評。

example.en: More haste, less speed.
example.zh: 欲速則不達。

example.en: She felt her dislike rapidly deepening to hatred.
example.zh: 她感到她的厭惡正迅速加深為仇恨。

example.en: You have to be hawk-eyed when there are small children about.
example.zh: 周圍有幼兒時要目光銳利。

example.en: Can you tell me how many bees there are in the hive?
example.zh: 你能否告訴我這個蜂巢裡有多少蜜蜂?

example.en: He hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
example.zh: 他把外套掛在門後的鉤上。

example.en: The sun has risen above the horizon.
example.zh: 太陽已從地平線升起。

example.en: There are plenty of fire hoses in the building.
example.zh: 這幢建築物中有許多消防軟管。

example.en: The bloody murder is a crime against humanity.
example.zh: 這血腥的謀殺是違反人道的犯罪。

example.en: This state was hit by a hurricane and damaged badly.
example.zh: 該州被颶風襲擊並遭嚴重破壞。

example.en: The mother hushed the crying child.
example.zh: 母親使啼哭的孩子安靜下來。

example.en: The twins are identical in appearance and character.
example.zh: 這對雙胞胎在外貌和個性一模一樣。

example.en: We need two pieces of identification to open a bank account.
example.zh: 在銀行開戶需要雙證件。

example.en: "To pull one's leg" is an idiom.
example.zh: 「To pull one's leg」(開某人玩笑)是慣用語。

example.en: They didn't want to live idle lives.
example.zh: 他們不想過閒散的生活。

example.en: Please forgive my ignorance.
example.zh: 請原諒我的無知。

senses.zh: 一無所知的, 無知的

example.en: Many young people are ignorant about current politics.
example.zh: 許多年輕人對當前的政治一無所知。

example.en: Illustration is often used in teaching children.
example.zh: 兒童教育中常使用圖示法。

example.en: Superman is little Johnny's imaginary friend.
example.zh: 超人是小強尼想像中的朋友。

example.en: The imaginative author wove fascinating adventures.
example.zh: 那位想像力豐富的作家編織了引人入勝的冒險故事。

example.en: He has an ability to imitate any sound he has heard.
example.zh: 他有種能力,能模仿任何他聽過的聲音。

example.en: Canada has many immigrants from Europe.
example.zh: 加拿大有許多從歐洲來的移民。

example.en: Her silence implied consent.
example.zh: 她的沈默意味著同意。

example.en: The present trouble was imposed on him.
example.zh: 目前的困難是強加在他身上的。

example.en: The new teacher made a good impression on the students.
example.zh: 新教師給學生留下了一個好印象。

example.en: Today I gave my seat to a lady holding an infant.
example.zh: 今天我讓座給一位抱著嬰兒的女士。

example.en: Are you sure there is no danger of infection now?
example.zh: 你肯定現在已經沒有傳染的危險了嗎?

example.en: The government did nothing to curb inflation.
example.zh: 政府沒有採取措施遏止通貨膨脹。

example.en: His initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.
example.zh: 他起初驚訝然後很快轉變為欣喜。

example.en: He inserted the card into the ATM.
example.zh: 他將卡片插入自動提款機中。

example.en: An annual safety inspection of the elevators is carried out.
example.zh: 電梯每年作一次安全檢查。

example.en: Mother hens protect their young by instinct.
example.zh: 母雞保護小雞出於本能。

example.en: He instructed me to deliver the goods to a customer.
example.zh: 他吩咐我把貨送去給顧客。

example.en: Her husband is a driving instructor.
example.zh: 她丈夫是駕駛教練。

example.en: I said something about her new hairstyle, and she took it as an insult.
example.zh: 我對她的新髮型做了一些評論,她卻把我的話當成侮辱。

example.en: Do you have insurance on your house?
example.zh: 你的房子有保險嗎?

example.en: It's a job that requires considerable intellectual effort.
example.zh: 這是一份需要相當腦力的工作。

example.en: I intend to find out why he quit the game.
example.zh: 我打算查明他為何退賽。

example.en: The pain in my back was so intense that I couldn't sleep.
example.zh: 我的背太痛了,以致於我睡不著。

example.en: The poem showed great intensity of feeling.
example.zh: 這首詩表現出強烈的感情。

example.en: He took a six-week intensive English course before he left for the States.
example.zh: 出發去美國前,他上了六週密集的英文課。

example.en: His good intentions were rewarded.
example.zh: 他的善意得到了善報。

example.en: The new transfer student interacts well with other students in the class.
example.zh: 新來的轉學生和班上其他人互動很好。

example.en: I turned down the radio lest it (should) interfere with his lessons.
example.zh: 我把收音機音量調低以免妨礙他上課。

example.en: The course is designed for learners at the intermediate level.
example.zh: 此課程是針對中等程度的學習者而設計的。

example.en: He spoke good Spanish and was to interpret for me.
example.zh: 他的西班牙語流利且將幫我翻譯。

example.en: The rain continued all day without interruption.
example.zh: 雨整天下個不停。

example.en: I am on intimate terms with coworkers.
example.zh: 我和同事間的感情很要好。

example.en: She sensed what was wrong by intuition.
example.zh: 她憑直覺意識到什麼地方出毛病了。

example.en: The investigation into the accident was carried out by two policemen.
example.zh: 兩名警察對這一事故展開調查。

example.en: The post office issued the stamps last week.
example.zh: 上星期郵局發行了這些邮票。

example.en: She is very keen on art.
example.zh: 她對藝術很感興趣。

example.en: The water in the kettle is boiling.
example.zh: 壶裡的水沸騰了。

example.en: She knelt down to pray.
example.zh: 她跪下來祈禱。

example.en: He turned the door knob, and the door opened.
example.zh: 他轉動門把，門就開了。

example.en: We have our Oral Communication class in the language laboratory.
example.zh: 我們語言實習室上口語溝通課。

example.en: The professor stayed in the research laboratory doing experiments all day.
example.zh: 教授整天待在實驗室作實驗。

example.en: There's a time lag of about a week between having the blood test and getting the results.
example.zh: 驗血和拿到結果之間，約有一週的時間差。

example.en: Mr. White's farm is largely corn land.
example.zh: 懷特先生的農場大多是玉米地。

example.en: The organization is to launch a campaign to raise money.
example.zh: 該機構將展開活動籌款。

example.en: It is not lawful to kill or injure a pet animal.
example.zh: 殺害或傷害寵物是不合法的。

senses.zh: 斜倚, 依靠, 依賴

example.en: That athlete is lean, tall and muscular.
example.zh: 那個運動員瘦又高，肌肉很多。

example.en: The magnetic field of our planet is made by swirling motions of molten iron in Earth's outer core.
example.zh: 地球磁場是由地球外核熔融的流動週期造成。

example.en: He's willing to do low-paid manual jobs.
example.zh: 他願做低薪資體力勞動的工作。

example.en: This car was designed and manufactured in Italy.
example.zh: 這輛車在義大利設計製造。

example.en: A marathon runner has to be able to keep running for 42.195 kilometers, without any intermediate supply of water and food.
example.zh: 一位馬拉松跑者要能連續跑 42.195 公里，期間接受最少量的食物和水供應。

senses.zh: 邊界,邊緣,留好空白以容納註記

example.en: Use double spacing and wide margins to leave room for comments.
example.zh: 隔行，留寬邊，才好留空白寫註記。
